name: campus-event-board
description: A campus events discovery and organizer platform built with MERN.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.ci:all: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
